note: Bedford County PA has no county zoning; 25 townships and 13 boroughs, most without zoning per the 2023 county hazard plan. The municipal zoning that exists is published as static PDF maps (Bedford Borough 2011 zoning map, Hopewell Township zoning map) or as an ARROtrac interactive viewer (Hopewell Township) with no queryable REST service found. The county parcel layer (PASDA BedfordCountyParcels202307) carries no zoning field. No official queryable district polygon layer was found after searching ArcGIS Online, PASDA, county, borough and township sites.
